projects.name: Waypoint OSINT

selected_models.change: ONNX; position embedding resampled to336 at export
one Riemannian Euler flow step exported to ONNX
split ONNX graphs with adaptive loop ported

coarse_pipeline: DINOv2 central square RGB→336 bicubic/ImageNet normalization
250 float32 SigmoidScheduler(-7,3,1) Euler steps using PLONK_YFCC ONNX
matching_pipeline: cap1024 bilinear then floor width/height to16; RGB float32
published modular LightGlue graphs with early stop/adaptive control
own bounded normalized8-point RANSAC with3px Sampson threshold

outputs.coarse: cluster coordinates/count/std, raw_score=sample_fraction_uncalibrated, bounded original sample_coordinates, noise fraction
outputs.matching: resized-frame pixel correspondences and assignment scores, keypoint/match counts, geometric inlier set
outputs.no_clusters: empty predictions; no fabricated best city
outputs.geometric_evidence: matching/epipolar agreement is not proof of geographic location

deviations_from_upstream: CPU keypoint cap1024 vs upstream2048, reported explicitly.
Own8-point geometry vs upstream7-point estimator, reported explicitly.
Python NumPy/ORT port of Rust control loop; exact selected graphs unchanged.
No CPU throughput calibration run during each user request.
